passages.note: Spieler traces the CCD architecture to work on integrated electronics on high-resistivity substrates and work on low-dark-current photodiode arrays for medical imaging. He identifies the 1990 and 1992 integration papers and the 1997 photodiode paper. The CCD device discussion cites 2003 measurements.
